parameters.description:
Relay a message to your own Kodi by posting a native `kodi` payload to the UnitySVC gateway.

`kodi-relay` accepts an HTTP POST with a native `kodi` payload. The gateway composes the upstream Kodi URL from your stored secrets and forwards the request, so your credentials never leave the platform.

Two channels are available: the free `byok` channel uses your own stored credentials; the `plus` channel binds extra per-enrollment destinations via enrollment parameters.
